source_archive.retention: NOT retained. Streamed through tar; only README.md and the four split CSVs were written to disk. The 15810 mmCIF structures were discarded in-stream.
source_archive.archive_md5_not_verified: The streamed archive was never materialised, so its md5 could not be recomputed locally; the Zenodo-published checksum above is recorded for citation. Per-file md5s of what we DID keep are below.

SAbDab2: The structural antibody database in the age of machine learning. bioRxiv (2026). doi:10.64898/2026.06.16.732554 (posted 2026-06-20; DOI and author list verified via Crossref, NOT via the malformed BibTeX in the record README)

splits.unit: antibody instance = PDB entry + author Hchain + author Lchain, variable region cropped, with retained antigen chains

flavours.ab_ag_split: antibody + antigen similarity (antigen-aware tasks; the applicable one for PRINCE)

splits.alignment: global Needleman-Wunsch, match +1, mismatch 0, gap-open -2, gap-extend -1 (polypeptide)
splits.grouping: connected-component join over base clusters, same topology as hotspot-preflight benchmark/cluster.py assign_clusters
splits.join_key: PDB_ID (pdb_0000xxxx) + Hchain + Lchain, author chain ids

structure_set_not_downloaded.format: mmCIF, variable region cropped + retained antigen chains
structure_set_not_downloaded.filename_key: pdb_<PDB_ID>_<VH_CHAINID>_<VL_CHAINID>.cif; absent chain of a single-domain antibody written as +
structure_set_not_downloaded.csv_join: the INSTANCE column equals the filename stem; also keyed on SABDAB_ID / HEAVY_ID / LIGHT_ID (IMGT numbering identifiers)
